before.top:
WoGification is about to begin!

After this message, there will be a delay while the map is converted to include WoG features (and then another message when it's done).

Hint: You can view current WoGify options during the game by choosing 'Save Game' and then clicking on the WoG Options button.
Option changes CANNOT be made during a game from this screen.
before.below: Large maps may take a few minutes on slow systems. Please be patient.
before.hint: The WoG Options button is located on the Scenario Selection screen.
